name: Minnesota Gopher Athletics
description: Sun Country's first custom livery, for the University of Minnesota's Gopher Athletics, on the 737-800 N809SY (tail 809): the 2018 scheme's layout in maroon and gold. Gold forward fuselage and nose with 'sun country' in maroon lower case over the windows and 'PROUD SPONSOR OF MINNESOTA GOPHER ATHLETICS' in small maroon capitals under it; over the wing the gold gives way to a white upper fuselage, the gold carried on as a band under it; behind the wing a maroon lower fuselage rising to the fin; the Minnesota block M (maroon outlined in gold) big on the white behind the wing, the registration and a small US flag aft of it; the fin gold with the sun-and-S in maroon and a maroon tip; maroon engines.

notes: Both of Sun Country's press photos show the left side from well ahead with a short lens, and neither fits the measured 737-800 well enough to trace the paint (the December 2024 one not at all; the 2025 one within 10 px at the nose, forward door and overwing exits, which it was fitted to, but 20-60 px off elsewhere). They show the 2018 standard's layout in maroon and gold, so the fuselage and fin areas are SCX/standard's, measured off N856SY, recoloured. Checked against the 2025 photo: the gold's edge over the wing crosses the window line at x 0.487 (the standard's at 0.483) and runs to the crown at about 0.41 (0.42): within the fit's error. Measured off that photo: 'sun country' from x 0.175 to 0.437 (the standard's from 0.149: the two placements may really differ by that, or it's the fit), its baseline just under the windows; the sub-title under it to about 0.40 (its start hidden by a passenger: placed just after the wordmark's start, as the 2024 photo shows it); the block M centered at x 0.564, from just above the window line's foot to near the top of the side (1.27 m tall, 0.67 of the radius), the two fits agreeing within 0.001 along the fuselage; the registration 0.609-0.631 and the flag after it. Left side only: no photo of the right side was found; it's drawn the same, and nothing shows whether it differs. Not drawn or unknown: the winglets (out of frame or edge-on in both photos: left out), whether the maroon carries the standard's fine contour lines (too small to see), and the ETOPS and '809' on the nose-gear door. No mascot (Goldy Gopher) appears in either photo or in the press coverage, so none is described. The block M is the university's mark; ours is a simplified slab-serif M in its colours.
